subject: Quick quarter-hour technical triage before full demo
messages:
From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@shoplinq.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick triage? Looking to confirm infra fit before a demo

Hi Mina,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and really like the throughput/latency notes on your docs. Before we commit to a full product demo for the broader infra team, could we do a very short technical sanity check — about 15 minutes — to make sure Redwood can meet a few constraints?

Quick context: ShopLinq is evaluating inference for on-prem inference in a hybrid setup (primary on-prem, failover to cloud). Our main concerns:
- KV cache persistence across restarts
- Quantized model performance on A100 vs older GPUs
- Network egress rules and ports for your Private deployment control plane

If possible, we can do the triage Monday or Tuesday morning PST. I attached a one-page requirements list.

Thanks,
Tom
CTO, ShopLinq
Attachment: shoplinq_sys_requirements.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@shoplinq.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick triage? Looking to confirm infra fit before a demo

Hi Tom — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the requirements doc.

15 minutes is perfect for a triage. I can cover the control-plane/networking checklist and Dev can jump in for the kernel/quantization questions.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Mon 8/24 08:30–08:45
- Mon 8/24 09:30–09:45
- Tue 8/25 10:00–10:15

If any of those work, I will send a short calendar invite and a one-page Redwood pre-demo checklist to set expectations. Also, quick note — our Private deployment requires an outbound TLS connection on port 443 to the control plane; we can show a diagram during the call.

Link to my quick scheduler if you prefer: https://cal.redwood.ai/mina/30min (pick any 15- or 30-min window and indicate "Pre-demo triage" in the notes).

Best,
Mina Haddad

See you Monday.

Tom
